state:
Goal `core-xml-node-and-1-more`: 1 of 3 members has its feature proofs on disk.
`Core\Xml\Node::attributes` is done: about.md, three examples, an attack, a bench with a recorded
figure, two `.nvst` cases and one Rust test, and a plain card. `Core\Xml\Node` now has its class
card (`NODE_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs`) and is off `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`.
The attributes slice found and fixed a bug: a literal tab, line feed or `\r\n` in an attribute
value now reads as one space (XML 1.0 § 3.3.3, and PHP's `DOMDocument` agrees), which is what
`quoted` in `xml.rs` already assumed when it writes those three as references.
`bun nv proofs --id` reads `target/release/nvs.exe` unless `--nvs target/covws/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/debug/nvs.exe`
is passed, so its help column can report a card that is already written.
`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/lib.rs` has an uncommitted change that is not this goal's (the `granting`
test helper canonicalizes grants). Leave it alone.

items.text: **`Core\Xml\Node::children`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf, tests (an existing `xml-*.nvst` case that calls `->children()` needs only a `// covers:` marker). Rewrite `CHILDREN_DOC` in the plain voice first: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs:438`, member at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs:2335`. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`

**`Core\Xml\Node::kind`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf, tests. Rewrite `KIND_DOC` plainly: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs:374`, member at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs:2289`. A bench here can declare `// bench: allocations 0`, since the member returns an enum case. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`

backlog: Text nodes may keep a literal `\r\n` as two characters, where XML 1.0 § 2.11 reads it as one `\n`. Not checked. Belongs to `Core\Xml\Node::text`, a member outside this goal; check with a probe before it goes in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs`'s `# Known gaps`.
The cards of `name`, `namespaceUri`, `text` and `source` are still in the dense voice. They are goal `plain-comments`'s to sweep.
